```{r}
keep_top_rows_df <- function(df,n_top=5) {
  # Create a new data frame with NA values
  df_new <- data.frame(matrix(NA, ncol = ncol(df), nrow = nrow(df)))
  rownames(df_new) <- rownames(df)
  colnames(df_new) <- colnames(df)
  
  # Loop through each column
  for (i in 1:ncol(df)) {
    # Select the top 5 rows for the current column
    top_rows <- order(df[, i], decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_top]
    
    # Copy the values from the original data frame to the new data frame
    df_new[top_rows, i] <- df[top_rows, i]
  }
  df_new <- df_new[rowSums(is.na(df_new)) != ncol(df_new), ]
  df_new[is.na(df_new)] = 0
  # Return the new data frame
  return(df_new)
}
```

## Pathway analysis
Reactome (v68) and the MSigDB C2 (v7.2) gene sets, using the positive and negative weights separately and the function run_enrichement, with default parameters
```{r}
data("reactomeGS")
```

```{r}
reactome <- read.csv("processing/reactome_v68_matrix_file.csv", row.names = 1)
reactome <- data.frame(t(reactome))
reactome$Genes <- rownames(reactome)
reactome$ID <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, reactome$Genes, keytype="SYMBOL", column= "ENSEMBL")
reactome <- reactome[!duplicated(reactome$ID),]
reactome <- reactome[!is.na(reactome$ID),]
rownames(reactome) <- reactome$ID
reactome$ID <- NULL
reactome$Genes <- NULL
rownames(reactome) <- paste0(rownames(reactome), ".p")
reactome <- t(reactome)
```





set.statistic = c("rank.sum"),
statistical.test = c("cor.adj.parametric")
alpha = 0.1,
```{r}
enrichment.parametric <- run_enrichment(
  MOFAobject,
  view = "Proteins",
  feature.sets = cell_types,
  factors = "all",
  sign = "positive",
  min.size = 10,
  nperm = 1000,
  p.adj.method = "fdr",
  verbose = TRUE
)

summary_table <- data.frame(enrichment.parametric$pval.adj)
summary_table[summary_table > 0.05] <- NA
summary_table <- stack(summary_table)
summary_table$Pathway <- rep(rownames(enrichment.parametric$pval.adj), 10)
summary_table_pos_cell_type <- summary_table[!is.na(summary_table$values),]
write.csv(summary_table_pos_cell_type, "processing/MOFA_table_nodes_cell_types_positive.csv", quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
table_overlap <- data.frame(Path_1 = NA, Path_2 = NA, Overlap = NA)

for (i in 2:nrow(reactome)-1) {
  for (j in i + 1:nrow(reactome)-i) {
    reactome_sub <- reactome[c(i,j),]
    genes <- colSums(reactome_sub)[colSums(reactome_sub) ==2]
    overlap <- length(genes)
    if (overlap > 30) {
      table_overlap_2 <- data.frame(Path_1 = rownames(reactome)[i], Path_2 = rownames(reactome)[j], Overlap = overlap)
      table_overlap <- rbind(table_overlap, table_overlap_2)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
table_correlation <- data.frame(Var1 = NA, Var2 = NA, R = NA, pval = NA)

for (i in 2:11) {
  for (j in 12:ncol(data)) {
    #print(colnames(data)[i])
    #print(colnames(data)[j])
    res2 <-cor.test(data[,i], data[,j],  method = "spearman")
    table_correlation_2 <- data.frame(Var1 = colnames(data)[i], Var2 = colnames(data)[j], R = res2$estimate, pval = res2$p.value)
    table_correlation <- rbind(table_correlation, table_correlation_2)
  }
}

table_correlation <- table_correlation[!is.na(table_correlation$Var1),]
table_correlation$FDR <- p.adjust(table_correlation$pval, method = "fdr")

write.csv(table_correlation, "processing/correlation_factors_cell_types_Dick.csv")
table_correlation_filt <- table_correlation[table_correlation$FDR < 0.05,]
table_correlation_filt <- table_correlation[abs(table_correlation$R) > 0.7,]
write.csv(table_correlation_filt, "processing/correlation_factors_cell_types_Dick_filt.csv")
table_correlation_cell <- table_correlation_filt
```

```{r}
table_correlation <- data.frame(Var1 = NA, Var2 = NA, R = NA, pval = NA)

  for (j in 12:ncol(data)) {
    #print(colnames(data)[i])

    table_correlation <- rbind(table_correlation, table_correlation_2)
  }
}

table_correlation <- table_correlation[!is.na(table_correlation$Var1),]
```

```{r}
for (i in c(1, 2, 4, 8)) {
  factor <- paste0("Factor",i)
  table_correlation_filt_2 <- table_correlation_filt[table_correlation_filt$Var1 == factor,]

  data_3 <- stack(data_2[,-1])

  ggplot(data_3, aes(x=data_3[, 3], y=values, group = ind, color=ind))+ 
    geom_smooth(method=lm, se=FALSE, fullrange=TRUE)+
    theme_classic()+ 
    stat_cor(method = "spearman", p.accuracy = 0.001, r.accuracy = 0.01)+xlab(factor)
  
  ggsave(paste0("results/figures/scatter_plot_correlation_top_pathways_", factor, ".png"), width = 7, height = 4)
}
```
